acceptance: NOT_YET_ESTABLISHED; configuration, guest image, VM and enforcement gates cannot be claimed before operational verification.
legitimate_elevation: Normal Windows UAC, elevated read-only probe reports administrator true.
prior_executor_inventory: Only existing WSL HCS VM; protected Hyper-V directory empty.
remaining_gate: Windows restart required; vmms unavailable; no guest or outer isolation established.
required_controls: fresh guest identity and dedicated volume
no drive, home, Git or reference sharing
no container or management socket exposed to guest
controlled NIC and disconnected final pre-execution network until exact provider policy is known
bounded media transfer without shared folders
selection_reason: Use Windows host hypervisor facility already present; add only full-VM hypervisor/service and PowerShell management components. No substitute outer boundary.
